acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc:
A nurse giving instructions to her partner in case she dies from COVID-19; a brother and sister talking every day, all of a sudden.
We first heard about nurse Elise Barrett in a story by Eric Boodman for STAT.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: The stories of undocumented people so often sound cliche. Writer Karla Cornejo Villavicencio has heard all of them, and thought she could do better.
acts.title: I Can’t Be Your Hero, Baby

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: The discovery of new information casts a new light on a high school competition. Producer Sean Cole talks to some of the people involved, more than a decade later.
acts.title: Popular Vote

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: A mysterious tunnel in Toronto leads to wild public speculation. Nick Kohler tells Ira the story behind the tunnel, which he wrote about for MacLean’s.
acts.title: Tunnel Vision
